papers.title: Discovering Valuable Items from Massive Data
papers.abstract: Suppose there is a large collection of items, each with an associated cost and an inherent utility that is revealed only once we commit to selecting it. Given a budget on the cumulative cost of the selected items, how can we pick a subset of maximal value? This task generalizes several important problems such as multi-arm bandits, active search and the knapsack problem. We present an algorithm, GP-Select, which utilizes prior knowledge about similarity be- tween items, expressed as a kernel function. GP-Select uses Gaussian process prediction to balance exploration (estimating the unknown value of items) and exploitation (selecting items of high value). We extend GP-Select to be able to discover sets that simultaneously have high utility and are diverse. Our preference for diversity can be specified as an arbitrary monotone submodular function that quantifies the diminishing returns obtained when selecting similar items. Furthermore, we exploit the structure of the model updates to achieve an order of magnitude (up to 40X) speedup in our experiments without resorting to approximations. We provide strong guarantees on the performance of GP-Select and apply it to three real-world case studies of industrial relevance: (1) Refreshing a repository of prices in a Global Distribution System for the travel industry, (2) Identifying diverse, binding-affine peptides in a vaccine de- sign task and (3) Maximizing clicks in a web-scale recommender system by recommending items to users.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注的是通用物品选择问题，不涉及有限元分析或代理模型，与用户方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No finite element analysis, surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanics context; focuses on active learning for item selection.

summary_zh.motivation: 从大量物品中高效选择高价值且多样的子集
summary_zh.method: 使用高斯过程预测和子模函数平衡探索与利用
summary_zh.result: 在多个工业案例中显著提升效率和效果
summary_zh.validation: 在真实世界数据集上实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently select a subset of high-value and diverse items from a large collection under a budget constraint.
summary_en.method: GP-Select employs Gaussian process prediction and a monotone submodular function to balance exploration and exploitation for diverse selection.
summary_en.result: Achieves up to 40x speedup in experiments and demonstrates strong performance in travel, vaccine design, and recommender systems.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation on three real-world industrial case studies.

papers.title: Inverse iterative simulation: An efficient approach for contaminant source identification
papers.abstract: In groundwater contaminant remediation and risk assessment, it is important to identify parameters of the contaminant source and hydraulic conductivity field by solving an inverse problem. However, if the dimensionality of the inverse problem is high, it is usually computationally expensive to obtain accurate estimation and uncertainty assessment of these parameters. This is particularly the case when Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling is used. In this paper, an efficient approach entitled inverse iterative simulation (iIS) is proposed to efficiently identify the contaminant source characteristics, together with the hydraulic conductivity field. The iIS algorithm utilizes a simple approach borrowed from Ensemble Smother (ES) to update model parameters and an inverse Gaussian process (iGP) approach to improve the accuracy of parameter updating. Two numerical experiments are tested. For the low dimensional case (with 11 parameters), the iIS algorithm can obtain parameter estimation very close to that of MCMC method. For the high dimensional case (with 108 parameters), the iIS algorithm can obtain accurate parameter estimation with very low computational cost.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法通过逆高斯过程代理模型高效求解高维逆问题，可迁移至植入物设计中的计算昂贵仿真问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, FEA surrogates for structural mechanics, or uncertainty quantification for implant design validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效识别地下水污染源参数，降低计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 结合集成平滑器和逆高斯过程进行迭代参数更新。
summary_zh.result: 在低维和高维问题上均取得准确估计，且计算成本低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently identify contaminant source parameters and hydraulic conductivity field with reduced computational cost compared to MCMC.
summary_en.method: An inverse iterative simulation algorithm using iterative Ensemble Smoother and inverse Gaussian process surrogate.
summary_en.result: Accurate parameter estimation in both low-dimensional (11 parameters) and high-dimensional (108 parameters) cases with low computational cost.

papers.title: 3D bioprinting for skin grafts
papers.venue: Journal of Bioengineering and Biomedical Sciences

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文讨论的是3D生物打印用于皮肤移植，没有涉及人工智能，与AI生物打印方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not integrate AI into any bioprinting workflow stage, lacks experimental validation of AI models, and does not address autonomous decision-making in bioprinting.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述3D生物打印在皮肤移植中的应用现状。
summary_zh.result: 总结了3D生物打印皮肤移植的进展与挑战。

summary_en.motivation: This review summarizes the current state of 3D bioprinting for skin graft fabrication.
summary_en.method: It is a literature review without presenting novel methods.
summary_en.result: The review outlines progress and challenges in bioprinted skin grafts.
